headline: A 2018 House resolution would have impeached President Donald Trump for high misdemeanors, based on his statements as President, but the House tabled it.
what_it_does: The resolution would have impeached President Donald John Trump, which means the House would formally charge him with misconduct. It would have set out one article of impeachment based on his statements as President that allegedly caused harm to American society and manifest injury to the people of the United States. The House voted on January 19, 2018 to table the measure, which set it aside and ended this action.

who_it_affects.how: If adopted, he would have been formally charged by the House, which would have started a process that could lead to a Senate trial.
If the House had impeached him, the Senate would have been responsible for holding a trial on the charge.
